purpose: Fresh audit-only prospective validation of the deterministically reproduced M10J_C0212 SHORT family, using its own brand-new immutable MT5-server start, without reusing or modifying M10P.

data.source_resolution: Reuse M8B LATEST/06_symbol_metadata.json mt5_files_root exactly, as used by M10B/M10E/M10P.

feature_definitions.h4_ema20_30_bps: At each M15 decision, use latest fully closed H4. Compute (EMA20-EMA30)/abs(H4 close)*10000 bps using standard EMA recursion identical to M10J/M10P1.
feature_definitions.h1_atr_pct100: At each M15 decision, use latest fully closed H1. Compute Wilder ATR14, then percentile100 as count(last 100 ATR values <= current ATR)/100, identical to M10I/M10J/M10P1.
feature_definitions.causal_context: Only H1/H4 bars fully closed at or before the M15 decision are eligible.

candidate.entry: Virtual exact M1 open bid at the eligible M15 decision. Exact timestamp required.
candidate.exit: Virtual exact M1 open ask exactly 240 minutes after entry; ask = M1 open + spread_points * point. Exact timestamp required; missing exact exit becomes EXIT_DATA_GAP and is never backfilled.
candidate.overlap_rule: While an accepted candidate is within its scheduled 240-minute holding interval, later eligible C0212 candidates are ONE_POSITION_ACTIVE skips. Candidate exactly at prior scheduled exit is allowed.

fresh_start_bootstrap.start_freeze_rule: Resolve M8B mt5_files_root; verify six live CSVs; take two identical tail snapshots 2 seconds apart; verify lag bounds; freeze immutable row-prefix fingerprints; set M10P2 start to latest CLOSED M1 server-open.

review_gates.interpretation: Checkpoints are manual research reviews only. C0212 historical PF target is positive-edge preservation, not automatic PF2 promotion.
